say:2:1421144001:1.text: Sorry, Otivia. I didn't expect Imperator Ravion to be so unhelpful...
say:2:1421144001:1.source_cn: 抱歉，欧蒂薇，我没想到沙利叶大人不靠谱……

say:3:1421144002:1.text: Actually, I know he's unreliable, but his actions yesterday were a new low.
say:3:1421144002:1.source_cn: 不，我知道他是个不靠谱的人，但没想到他会这么不靠谱！

say:4:1421144003:1.text: Most of the guards from Indris' batch have left service, but I can still track a few down for you.
say:4:1421144003:1.source_cn: 虽然跟因度厄同期的卫兵很多都找不到人了，但我努努力，还...

say:5:1421144004:1.text: It's not necessary, Xera! I've completed the third verse already!
say:5:1421144004:1.source_cn: 啊，不必了，席蕾！我已经得到了灵感，并且写完了第三段故事！

say:6:1421144005:1.text: I hope it's not about Indris' wild, drunken behavior.
say:6:1421144005:1.source_cn: 你该不会就是写因度厄酒量差发酒疯这些东西吧？

say:7:1421144006:1.text: I know you're trying to make the poem more relatable, but writing about gossip is taking it a bit too far...
say:7:1421144006:1.source_cn: 虽然说吟游诗人的创作要通俗，但也不能是这种八卦吧……

say:8:1421144007:1.text: Please have faith in me, Xera! My poem is completely based on facts!
say:8:1421144007:1.source_cn: 怎么会呢，放心吧，席蕾！我不会瞎编乱造的，一切都是出于事实！

say:9:1421144008:1.text: Also, the third verse really ties everything together when it comes to the emotional flow.
say:9:1421144008:1.source_cn: 而且，从情感的延续上，第三段也确实完成了承上启下的需求。

say:10:1421144009:1.text: I used a slightly different narrative perspective and style, making the lines feel more dynamic...
say:10:1421144009:1.source_cn: 只是稍微更换了一下叙事的视角与使用的笔法，让整体的诗句...

say:11:1421144010:1.text: Ugh! My head hurts with all the jargon... So, why did you gather us here?
say:11:1421144010:1.source_cn: 好了好了，文学创作的事我一听就头疼……那叫我们过来是？

say:12:1421144011:1.text: I'm going to work on the final verse: A Hero Is Born!
say:12:1421144011:1.source_cn: 是这样，我需要写诗歌的最后一段，英雄的诞生！

say:13:1421144012:1.text: It's about the dragon, the Queen, Sal'thorin, and sunlight!
say:13:1421144012:1.source_cn: 关于龙，关于女王，关于萨洛克兰，关于阳光！

choice_prompt:14:1421144012.text: It's about the dragon, the Queen, Sal'thorin, and sunlight!
choice_prompt:14:1421144012.source_cn: 关于龙，关于女王，关于萨洛克兰，关于阳光！

say:15:1421144013:1.text: It'd be helpful if I could check out Helthor's temple and the place where the dragon once lived. Could you take me there?
say:15:1421144013:1.source_cn: 所以，拜托嘛，拜托了！能不能带我去赫托神殿，以及那位龙...

say:16:1421144014:1.text: The temple is now closed to the public, and there's nothing I can do to get around that. As for the dragon, I have no clue about it...
say:16:1421144014:1.source_cn: 神殿那边现在闲人禁入，这我也没办法通融，至于龙，我是一...

choice_prompt:17:1421144014.text: The temple is now closed to the public, and there's nothing I can do to get around that. As for the dragon, I have no clue about it...
choice_prompt:17:1421144014.source_cn: 神殿那边现在闲人禁入，这我也没办法通融，至于龙，我是一无所知……

say:18:1421144015:1.text: Hmm, in that case, I can only write about what everyone already knows...
say:18:1421144015:1.source_cn: 唔，这样的话，最后就只能是众所周知的英雄诞生的故事了啊……

say:19:1421144016:1.text: Could you share a bit more about your adventure with Indris, Magister?
say:19:1421144016:1.source_cn: 不能再多透露点冒险的消息给我吗，拜托了，魔法师大人——

say:21:1421144017:1.source_cn: 太好了！伟大的英雄之旅，马上启程！
